name: ditto-plugins
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for Ditto - the peer-to-peer sync platform

plugins.name: ditto-dql
plugins.description: DQL (Ditto Query Language) assistance for writing queries, subscriptions, and data operations

plugins.name: ditto-mesh
plugins.description: Ditto mesh networking and transport configuration — transports, peer discovery, runtime config updates, and transport-aware data modeling

plugins.name: ditto-subscriptions
plugins.description: How Ditto sync subscriptions work: query rules and limitations, mesh propagation, multi-hop flooding, and troubleshooting missing documents

plugins.name: ditto-data-modeling
plugins.description: CRDT-aware data modeling for Ditto: REGISTER/MAP/COUNTER/ATTACHMENT semantics, embed vs split decisions, document size budgets, and JSON review across SDK 4.14.x and 5.x

plugins.name: ditto-swift
plugins.description: Ditto Swift SDK guidance for iOS, iPadOS, macOS and Mac Catalyst apps — DittoConfig and Ditto.open, sync and subscriptions, DQL execution, store observers and DittoDiffer, attachments, presence, Swift 6 concurrency, and 4.14.x/5.0.x/5.1.x version differences
